notes.title: The next Suspicious game
notes.notes:
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1283890/Suspicious_Spaceroads/]Suspicious Spaceroads[/url][/b] rolls its way into the platforming genre, and much like [b]Suspicious Slide[/b] offers a twist in the puzzle genre, Spaceroads is no different.

There's a 50% chance you'll like the twist it provides. [i]Luckily[/i], the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/14165/Suspicious_Bundle/]Suspicious Bundle[/url] offers a 50% discount to make it a [b]100%[/b] chance it'll be a great time. That's pure maths, baby. 

Get on it! :)

notes.title: Stay-At-Home Discount
notes.notes:
Critically acclaimed* indie puzzle game makes it way into your heart through it's week-long sale starting from 3/30 at a price you can't refuse.**

Hope everyone is staying safe. Definitely been practicing for this moment all my life, gamers unite! :D

* I consider myself my harshest critic.
** Well, you could, but why would you want to?! (Unless you don't like fun, which is the only reason I will accept!)
